/**
 * @name Command execution sinks in setuptools
 * @description Identifies calls to subprocess, os.system, os.popen, and distutils spawn
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-execution-audit
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string detail
where
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("tools/%") and
  (
    exists(SystemCommandExecution cmd | call = cmd and detail = "SystemCommandExecution: " + call.toString())
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "run", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    detail = "subprocess call"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall() and
    detail = "os command call"
  )
select call, detail + " in " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + ":" + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Identify all OS command execution points in setuptools to check for command injection or unsafe shell=True usage

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command execution details in bdist_rpm and shell invocations
 * @description Inspect arguments passed to os.system, os.popen, and subprocess with shell
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-args-inspection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg0
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() and
    arg0 = call.getArg(0)
  )
  or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "run", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    exists(call.getArgByName("shell")) and
    arg0 = call.getArg(0)
  )
select call, "Command call with arg: " + arg0.asExpr().toString() + " in function " + call.getScope().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Check os.system, os.popen, and subprocess calls with shell keyword argument for potential command injection

message.text: Command call with arg: q_cmd in function Function run

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Archive extraction calls
 * @description Audit tarfile/zipfile extraction and wheel/archive unpacking for path traversal (ZipSlip/TarSlip)
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/archive-extract-calls
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 *       external/cwe/cwe-073
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  f = call.getScope() and
  not f.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("setuptools/_vendor/backports/tarfile/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport(["tarfile", "zipfile"]).getMember(["open", "ZipFile", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall", "_extract_member"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember("unpack_archive").getACall() or
    call.asExpr().(Call).getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["extract", "extractall", "_extract_member", "unpack_archive"]
  )
select call, "Archive extraction call in " + f.toString() + " (" + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + ":" + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString() + ")"
findings.hypothesis: Check tarfile, zipfile, and wheel extraction methods for ZipSlip / TarSlip path traversal vulnerabilities

/**
 * @name Network SSL and Insecure Tempfile Audit
 * @description Audit network requests, SSL context creation, and insecure temporary file creation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/network-ssl-tempfile-audit
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 *       external/cwe/cwe-377
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall()
select call, "Sensitive network, SSL, or tempfile call"
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure SSL contexts, SSRF sinks via urllib, or insecure tempfile.mktemp usage in setuptools
